_meta.note: TRANSLATION DRAFT — review with a native Dari (Farsi-Afghanistan) speaker before launch. Freight/logistics terminology in particular should be checked against local industry usage.
reviewChecklist: Common freight terms: FCL, LCL, B/L, AWB — confirm whether transliterated or translated
Border-crossing names — confirm local Dari spelling
Formality/register — b2b freight buyers, direct not floral
Numbers/dates — verify Persian numerals vs Western digits preference
